Workouts and technique drills designed for intermediate boulderers

This 6-week program is designed for intermediate-level boulderers (V5-V8 or 6C-7B+) that are looking to incorporate a mixture of technique-focused climbing drills and strength work.  This program was built in collaboration with Emil Abrahamsson as part of his 3-part training series on going from V0 to V15 and looks to address the skills that he sees as most important for bouldering specialists.  

This program is best suited for climbers that wish to train 3 days per week.  During the first week of the program athletes will assess their current finger strength and max pull-ups. 

A suggested weekly schedule for the program is:

Session 1: Max Hangs & Lock-off Training
Session 2: Dyno Training & Weighted Pull-ups
Session 3: Campus Bouldering
